text: In Havana's Koh-lohn Cemetery lies Amelia Goyri.
text0: In Havana's Colón Cemetery lies Amelia Goyri.

text: After her death, her grieving husband would knock on her tomb… as though he could wake her.
But here's where the legend turns chilling.
They say her baby was buried at her feet.
When the tomb was opened years later, Amelia's body was untouched… And the baby was now in her arms.
A mother's love beyond death… or a story the living couldn't bear to let go?
